title: A pack whose closest line to the question is the article's own UNK not-stated line says coverage good with no check: line
goal: rag.py pack prints a check: line, with no change of the verdict, when the line that matches the question's key words best is an UNK line saying the fact is not stated, so a lookup and a gap sweep do not read the kb's own not-stated line as an answer

run: import subprocess,sys;o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/rag.py","pack","Whether /MIR and /PURGE delete destination files that /XF or /XD exclude"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;g=o.startswith("coverage: good");c=any(l.startswith("check:") for l in o.splitlines());print("good",g,"check",c);sys.exit(1 if g and not c else 0)

clauses.clause: rag.py pack prints a check: line, with no change of the verdict, when the line that matches the question's key words best is an UNK line saying the fact is not stated, so a lookup and a gap sweep do not read the kb's own not-stated line as an answer

notes: Found 2026-11-09 by a gap sweep where 60 of 60 open gaps packed good on such lines. Premise: the repro fails on 55dde769f (good True, check False). The pack is built in kf_index.py (check lines near evidence_note) and kbfacts.py; the lookup eval at landing guards against false check: lines on expected-good rows (rag.py eval, NOTED_BASELINE).
